title: IBAN Validator + BIC Lookup + SEPA Reachability
description: Validates IBANs using MOD 97 check digit algorithm across all IBAN countries. Validates BIC/SWIFT codes and checks SEPA reachability. Supports batch CSV validation with full export.

batchCSV.description: CSV with one IBAN per row for batch mode

mcp_tool_definition.name: validate_iban_bic
mcp_tool_definition.description: Validate an IBAN using MOD 97 check digit and a BIC against SWIFT format rules. Returns validation status, country, bank code, and SEPA reachability. Also supports batch IBAN validation. Use when an agent needs to verify payment account identifiers before initiating a transfer.
